name: GH1900 Nen ~Honoo no Katana Nite Seigi o Nasu~
original_name: GH1900年～焔の刀にて正義を成す～
source:
On a faraway planet, a shrine maiden of the eastern territory of Chronos has been abducted.
The incident was premeditated, and set in motion a series of consequent events.
A Flamesword Knight named Yukino Hiiragi wields her weapon to resolve all wrongs.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE087438.html]DLsite English[/url]]
